text:
Maya - Finance: Heads up — found a duplicate vendor invoice that will affect our month-end deferrals. ACME sent two lines that look identical for the Q3 hosted commit promo. Invoice refs: INV-5421 and INV-5421-dup. :eyes:
Priya - Billing: saw this in the queue, flagged INV-5421-dup as potential duplicate. The vendor confirmed they re-sent due to internal system retry.
Liam - RevRec: If we book both, deferred revenue will be overstated. We need to ensure only one makes it into the revenue schedule for Sep close. Can we block the duplicate from posting to AR?
Priya - Billing: I put a hold on the dup in the AR system and added a note: "hold — duplicate, vendor confirmed". Will not post until we decide.
Jo - Revenue Ops: Thanks. For month-end entries, we should: 1) keep the original invoice posted, 2) treat the dup as vendor credit to be applied next billing cycle, or 3) ask for a formal credit memo. Which does finance prefer? :thinking_face:
Maya - Finance: Preference is a credit memo so we don't have to do manual reversals in the close window. But if vendor turnaround is slow, a temporary credit (internal clearing) is ok as long as it's documented. We need an audit trail for the deferral entry change.
Priya - Billing: I'll request a credit memo from ACME now and put the dup on hold until we receive it. Noting expected turnaround 3-5 business days.
Liam - RevRec: For entries, prepare one of these journal options depending on outcome: 
```
# If vendor issues credit memo before close
DR Accounts Receivable - INV-5421-dup    $8,400
CR Vendor Credit Memo Liability           $8,400
# Reverse duplicate deferral if already booked
DR Deferred Revenue                       $8,400
CR Revenue - Hosted API                   $8,400
```
Or if no credit memo before close, we book an internal clearing liability: 
```
DR Accounts Receivable                    $8,400
CR Other Current Liabilities - Clearing   $8,400
```
We must include note linking to ACME email thread and billing ticket.
Maya - Finance: Good. Also update the revenue schedule to exclude the dup. I'll add a manual override flag on the schedule row for INV-5421.
Priya - Billing: Filing ticket with vendor now: Ticket #BILL-9982, asked for credit memo and proof of duplicate. I pasted vendor reply in the ticket.
billing-bot: Duplicate invoice alert: INV-5421-dup flagged by rule "vendor_retry_dup". Created incident billing/29812.
Jo - Revenue Ops: Can someone add the manual override note to the close checklist? @Maya @Liam
Maya - Finance: Done — checklist item "exclude ACME duplicate invoice INV-5421-dup" added and assigned to Liam for verification.
Liam - RevRec: I'll verify tomorrow morning and sign off on the schedule. If credit memo arrives before EOD, we'll apply and close as usual. If not, we'll use the internal clearing journal and unwind when memo arrives.
Priya - Billing: Will follow up with vendor daily. I'll ping this thread when the credit memo comes in. :thumbsup:
Maya - Finance: Thanks team. Quick note for the audit folder: save the AR hold screenshot, vendor email, billing ticket ID, and the journal entry template Liam posted.
Priya - Billing: Copying documents to /shared/finance/audit/ACME_INV_5421_duplicates.
Jo - Revenue Ops: Marking this as resolved in the close tracker once Liam signs off. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
